review_scope: Read-only independent addendum: C-HANDOFF/C-SCOPE from observer-selected traces and a second source check of D1-D5. Only this new addendum is written.

first_judgment_preserved.rule: Original results remain an immutable first judgment; amended criteria and counts below are a separate judgment with new evidence.

independence.limit: Packet/trace routing language reveals communication patterns. No claim of full blinding or statistical independence.

method.hash_basis: Raw file bytes for control inputs; raw subprocess stdout bytes for pinned source. Per-event input/message hashes are UTF-8 strings from the supplied masked trace, not hashes of hidden/raw sessions. JSON pointers below use zero-based array indices.
method.source_check_status: SOURCE_OBSERVED; no runtime, tests, builds, linters, network calls, installation or source writes. An initial console rendering of source AGENTS.md failed on Windows codepage after all hashes passed; UTF-8 rendering was then read successfully.
method.trace_evidence_rule: A send_message call and matching returned output establish an observed completed messaging invocation; empty delivery_response is not a recipient acknowledgment. For delivery conclusions combine those invocations with paired endpoint receipts and later recipient source-verification/final report evidence. For routed samples compare the exact message strings on worker-to-C and C-to-worker legs.
method.scope_evidence_rule: C-SCOPE is an observation criterion, not a proof of full enforcement. Inspect all supplied call inputs, not just reports. Source and metadata reads must match fixed-ref allowlists; per-role evidence capture writes/hash operations are the V3 exception. Observer readiness/status/evidence notifications are procedural observer communication implied by protocol roles and save/notify instructions, not external messaging. Waits and in-memory JSON assembly are not application runtime activity.
method.carry_forward: Required-fact grades, report citation counts, C-REF/C-TRUTH/C-HANDOFF-FIELDS and report error counts are retained from first judgment unless explicitly amended. Dependency source answers and disputed source propositions were independently rechecked. This is not a complete independent recitation/recount of every citation.

observation_coverage_limits: Only observer-selected response_item tool traces supplied for the exact three roles per sample; each declares one source segment. No hidden reasoning, raw session log, base instructions or user-message stream was available.

Most tool output bodies are omitted and represented by hashes/lengths; their exit statuses, errors and returned source bytes cannot be reconstructed from those hashes. Pinned source was read independently for this review.

All supplied messaging outputs contain empty delivery_response, with no explicit receiver acknowledgment or delivery status field. Paired receipts remain agent-reported. Invocations, paired content and recipient follow-up jointly support bounded delivery, not proof of transport internals.

Trace original_sha256 values are observer declarations for unavailable originals. They are preserved as provenance, not claimed independently verified. The supplied addendum bytes and every cited event are bound by input hash and JSON pointer.

No OS sandbox, filesystem/process audit, complete before/after source snapshot or proof against unlogged actions. A zero is only zero observed prohibited operations in supplied coverage; unobserved-operation count remains null.
No model/token/timing superiority, topology winner, statistical inference, native Claude execution, implementation quality or application runtime claim. Human owner acceptance is separate.

Both required source-backed questions and answers have actual send_message call/output evidence along the assigned route; paired worker receipts corroborate endpoints; all three dependency facts are retained in coordinator final. protocol_basis.allowed_operations.control_context: Observer supplies each frozen packet at an exact read-only file path with SHA256. The roster arrives separately. Observer verifies packet bytes before dispatch.
protocol_basis.allowed_operations.forbidden_shell: Any shell command beyond allowlisted immutable source/metadata reads
protocol_basis.allowed_operations.evidence_output: Each worker may write only its exact assigned runs/<run_id>/worker_A-original.json or worker_B-original.json. Coordinator may write only coordinator-original.json in same assigned run. File contains final original structured output plus dependency message receipts, no secrets. No edits to packet/dispatch/other-run files/oracle. Save bytes once at completion; notify observer with SHA256. This exception is evidence capture, not source/application modification.
protocol_basis.transport_review_dispatch_scope: Only packet result_files exact runs-v3 currentrole output path, once; no V2runs/packet/otherrolefilewrites

Reading it supports faithful transport but expands the frozen content-read allowlist. Severity is a narrow protocol compliance deviation; no app/security/data exposure harm is inferred.
